description: Desktop pet window (/pet): listen for pet-visibility / pet-summary / pet-tour-start, ask main for a summary (emit), read monitors, move and resize itself (wider and taller while a speech bubble shows), show its native right-click menu (core:menu, via core:default), quit the app (menu item, same path as Cmd-Q). The pet_* app commands need no entry (the app defines no command ACL manifest).
